items.title: Junior Mance Part II interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 18, 1999 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: Ben Brown, the bass player, gave me Finale and Encore because I think he upgraded and he gave me probably the older ones.

ctx.x: Ben Brown, the bass player, gave me Finale and Encore because I think he upgraded and he gave me probably the older ones. But I still haven’t learned how to use them.
There’s enough there to learn, believe me.
